messages.author: Nikolay N. Kuzmich
messages.body:
Dear Amber users,
please tell me which graphic cards will suit for absolute binding
alchemical free energy calculations with Amber22?
What is the minimum amount of GPU memory required?
I had some experience with Schrodinger/Desmond ABFE, so V100 32Gb was okay
and RTX 2080Ti was not.
Kind regards
Nick
